segments.name: Kakarbhitta – Itahari
segments.expect: Flat Terai highway; fast moving outside towns.

segments.name: Daunne (Nawalparasi)
segments.expect: Chronic chokepoint: road collapses, dust and hours-long jams; upgrade works drag on — expect a slow crawl.

segments.name: Butwal – Kohalpur
segments.expect: Flat Terai run; heavy truck traffic.

segments.name: Kohalpur – Mahendranagar
segments.expect: Long flat far-west run; fuel up — services thin out at night.

travel_notes.surface: Mostly blacktopped; flat and fast across the Terai, hillier in the west.
travel_notes.typical_time: End to end (≈1,028 km) is a 20+ hour bus journey — plan overnight halts.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: High at Daunne; Terai sections can flood in heavy rain.
hazards: Daunne (Nawalparasi): chronic chokepoint — road collapses, dust and hours-long jams; upgrade works drag on for years.
Terai stretches flood in sustained monsoon rain; check waterlogging near river crossings.

segments.name: Kechana – Ilam
segments.expect: Terai-to-hills climb.

segments.name: Ilam – Rajduwali
segments.expect: Slide-prone: the section was fully cut off in July 2026 and the Rajduwali slide keeps moving.

segments.name: Rajduwali – Olanchungola
segments.expect: Remote hill stretch toward the northern border.

travel_notes.surface: Hill road, partly blacktopped; rough in stretches.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: High — the Ilam–Rajduwali section was completely cut off in July 2026 and the Rajduwali landslide keeps sliding.
hazards: Ilam–Rajduwali: obstructed by landslides (July 2026); cuts Ilam, Panchthar and Taplejung off from the Tarai.
Belase–Bhanjyang alternative stays muddy and dilapidated even in normal rain.

segments.name: Eastern section
segments.expect: Hilly, partly under construction — expect gravel stretches.

segments.name: Parbat (Kaligandaki)
segments.expect: Live DoR record Sep 27, 2026: river washed out the highway at chainage 64+200.

segments.name: Rukum East
segments.expect: Night travel banned here after landslide blockages; rocky terrain, rockfalls common.

segments.name: Western section
segments.expect: Remote hill highway — limited services.

travel_notes.surface: ~1,776 km proposed; ~1,259 km tarred, rest under construction — expect gravel stretches.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: Among Nepal's hardest highways in monsoon; rocky hill sections shed rockfalls and debris.
travel_notes.night_rules: Night vehicular movement has been banned in Rukum East sections after landslide blockages.
hazards: Rukum East: night travel banned where landslides blocked the road.
Rockfalls and debris deposition are common on rocky hill sections.
Live DoR record (Sep 27, 2026): Kaligandaki river washed out the highway at chainage 64+200, Parbat.

segments.name: Rani – Dharan
segments.expect: Terai approach.

segments.name: Dharan – Dhankuta
segments.expect: Critical climb: landslides at Mulghat and Namaste Jharna; Leuti river washes away road at Phedigaun almost every monsoon; Phedi river at Ghante washed away 30 m of blacktop. Travel early — rain builds through the afternoon.

segments.name: Dhankuta – Hile
segments.expect: Hill section onward to the northern districts.

segments.name: Hile – Kimathanka
segments.expect: Remote high-hill stretch to the Tibet border.

travel_notes.surface: Blacktopped Dharan–Dhankuta–Hile; tight hairpin bends climbing out of Dharan.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: High June–September: start early — rain builds through the afternoon and roads close for hours after heavy rain.
hazards: Dharan–Dhankuta: landslides at Mulghat and Namaste Jharna have fully blocked the road.
Leuti river at Phedigaun washes away ~100 m of road almost every monsoon; Phedi river at Ghante washed away 30 m of blacktop.
This is the critical link to Bhojpur, Sankhuwasabha, Taplejung and Panchthar — when it closes, the east hills are stranded.

segments.name: Eastern section (Jhapa–Dharan)
segments.expect: Under construction — gravel, narrow lanes, missing barriers.

segments.name: Sindhuli–Hetauda
segments.expect: Inner-Terai construction zone; thin surfacing and potholes.

segments.name: Doti (Kera Bari)
segments.expect: Live DoR record Sep 27, 2026: PARTIAL_OPEN at chainage 72+800.

segments.name: Western section
segments.expect: Remote; long unfinished stretches.

travel_notes.surface: Under construction (1,200–1,390 km planned; ~240 km blacktopped). Expect gravel, narrow lanes, missing barriers and markings.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: High — the Sep 2024 floods severely destroyed sections.
hazards: Ongoing construction zone: thin surfacing, potholes, no safety barriers on many stretches.
Live DoR record (Sep 27, 2026): PARTIAL_OPEN at Kera Bari, Doti (chainage 72+800).

travel_notes.surface: Paved to Barabise; beyond that a narrow shelf cut into the cliff above the Bhote Koshi gorge.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: Extreme June–September beyond Barabise — closures are frequent; verify before travel.
hazards: Beyond Barabise: one of Nepal's most landslide-prone sections — steep unstable hillsides both sides of the gorge.
Slide points at Daklang, Ghattekhola and Kodari; the road was fully closed Aug 24 – Sep 22, 2025.
Tatopani–Kodari border crossing status changes at short notice — confirm before heading up.

corridors.name: Galchhi–Rasuwagadhi
corridors.via: Malekhu, Galchhi, Trishuli Bazaar, Betrawati, Mailung, Syabrubesi

segments.expect: Southern section.

segments.name: Betrawati – Dhunche (via Mailung)
segments.expect: Partially restored; 4WD detour conditions.

segments.name: Dhunche – Syabrubesi
segments.expect: NO ROAD since the Aug 26, 2026 flood — helicopter or foot only.

segments.name: Syabrubesi – Rasuwagadhi (Timure)
segments.expect: Border road; through access not confirmed.

travel_notes.surface: Severely damaged — ~40 km of road and 41 bridges destroyed in the Aug 26, 2026 Bhotekoshi flood.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: Extreme — do not plan through-travel until DoR confirms restoration.
travel_notes.vehicle_limits: Light 4WD only on the detour; no vehicles beyond Dhunche.
hazards: NO ROAD between Dhunche and Syabrubesi — reachable only by helicopter or on foot.
Detour to Dhunche: narrow single-lane via Tokha–Chhahare–Bogatitar–Kalikasthan; poor condition, held up by landslides and mud.
Ramche landslide zone (~3 km before Dhunche): active slope, 4WD recommended.
Postpone non-essential travel north of Dhunche (Langtang trailheads, Timure, Rasuwagadhi).

segments.expect: One-way system: Kathmandu → Hetauda uses this direction.

segments.name: Phakhel – Kulekhani
segments.expect: Light vehicles only; night movement suspended.

segments.name: Kulekhani – Bhimphedi (Sisneri)
segments.expect: Slide-prone at Sisneri; light vehicles only under the one-way system.

travel_notes.surface: Narrow mountain road via Phakhel and Kulekhani; scenic but slow.
travel_notes.typical_time: Kathmandu–Hetauda normally ≈ 3 hrs; ≈ 5 hrs under current diversions and jams.
travel_notes.monsoon_risk: Moderate — Sisneri stretch is slide-prone.
travel_notes.night_rules: Night movement suspended on the Kulekhani section.
travel_notes.vehicle_limits: Light vehicles only (< 14 seats). Larger cargo trucks cannot use this road.
hazards: One-way system in force: Kathmandu → Hetauda via Pharping–Phakhel–Kulekhani–Bhimphedi; return via Bhimphedi–Kulekhani–Sisneri–Dakshinkali.
Sisneri: landslide-prone — a slide at Thingdanda has closed the Kulekhani–Pharping section before.
